This is the matrix's midway gate: the furnace, air compressor, centrifuge, drills, kilns and Siemens-Martin stand in formation — pause here, audit the steam ledgers and main headroom, then push on.

Ahead, two reservoirs are already within sight; the next level, hub logistics, will weave the whole base's steam and water into one net.

§6Look back from the halfway mark and see how deep the bronze reserves run — every gate ahead is affordable.§r
